messages:
jamal-recruiter: Heads up 3: multiple interviewers reported 'no scorecard' in calendar for today's loop (candidate R-880).

jamal-recruiter: They all have the invite but body is empty. I asked them to check attachments, nothing.

sarah-peopleops: Can you paste invite id? we'll queue a manual patch if needed.

jamal-recruiter: invite id invite-7f4. Candidate scheduled 10:30-11:30.

ats-bot: ats-bot: webhook_delivery: delivery_id=9f1a - status=202 accepted -> later 409 conflict for invite-7f4

maria-hiringops: Checking ATS: scorecard object created at 1850012000 and linked to candidate R-880. Calendar enrichment webhook attempted twice. Second call returned 409 because mapping already existed but was in inconsistent state.

lily-int-trainer: Also saw two interviewers who said their "trained" badge wasn't showing in the panel UI. They completed the micro-training yesterday.

maria-hiringops: Training write is a separate event. If webhook ordering scrambled, roster cache could read stale value. I can see training event at 1850009000 and roster read at 1850012300.

tom-eng-mgr: Is this a deploy timing/race or an upstream calendar provider quirk?

maria-hiringops: Appears to be race triggered by the new bulk-invite flow we merged last night. Bulk flow creates invites first then fires enrichment jobs in parallel. Old path enriched sequentially.

kevin-intops: (cc @tom) We rolled the bulk flow flag last night to speed up invite issuance. I'll roll back the flag and add dedupe+idempotency checks to the enrichment worker. Quick fix: append scorecard link if enrichment hasn't completed in 20s.

jamal-recruiter: For now can recruiting send the manual follow-up email with the link? interviewers are starting now.

maria-hiringops: Sending manual patch and a short msg to panel with scorecard URL: https://ats.redwood/scorecards/R-880. Also updating the interview ops playbook with a checklist for invite verification.

sarah-peopleops: We'll add a "missing scorecard" indicator to the recruiter panel in ATS so folks can triage before panels. Putting this on the sprint backlog.

lily-int-trainer: Separately, we should show training completion timestamp on the roster hover so managers can verify.

kevin-intops: Will follow up with a short incident note and PR with fixes: 1) rollback bulk flag, 2) idempotent enrichment, 3) roster cache invalidation on training write.

jamal-recruiter: Thanks all. Quick win: if someone sees this be sure to reopen invite after patch so calendar clients refresh. :thumbsup:

ats-bot: ats-bot: calendar_patch_succeeded invite-7f4 at 1850012389

maria-hiringops: Confirmed patch applied, panel notified. I'll run a sweep for today's invites for similar failures and DM recruiters.

sarah-peopleops: Appreciated. We'll track as a recruiting ops bug and move to P1 for the sprint. :clap:
